sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset: transparent sprite atlas for a Vietnamese chibi 2D tower defense. One character only: THUNDER BULL, a stocky adorable muscular dark blue bull with large metallic gold horns, golden lightning veins and cloven hooves, absolutely no humanoid rider. Clean detailed hand-painted mobile game art, crisp outlines, top-down three-quarter view facing up toward enemies. EXACT uniform 8 columns by 4 rows grid, 32 separate fully visible frames, equal square cells, generous transparent padding, no grid lines or text. Row 1: 8 genuinely different subtle idle poses with breathing, ears and tail moving. Rows 2 and 3: 16 successive casting poses: crouch, charge horns, rear up, thrust horns upward releasing lightning, recover. Row 4: 8 summon poses materializing from sparks and landing. Same character size and foot anchor in each cell. Real pose changes, no repeated identical frames. Entire background transparent alpha, not a checkerboard. Sheet 2048x1024 if possible. No labels, no scenery.
